body.x: GOYANG, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2006') -- <Visual News> Samsung unveiled ''SCH-V900'', a red-wine-color 9.9mm ultra edition during KES 2006. It features a 2M camera, a 2.3-inch QVGA main screen, 0.8-inch 16 Gray OLED sub-screen and supports CDMA2000 1x EV-DO(800MHz) and GPS function. Other features include VOD/MOD/MP3 Player, a file viewer, Bluetooth connectivity, microSD memory card slot, “playing with my pet” and subway route map.
